classification_note: 205 membership differences were individually retained. Evidence supports 59 classifications: 28 J-Quants-only later delistings, 2 stale IRBANK inclusions of already-delisted issues, 15 new listings after the J-Quants effective date, 6 announced future listings present in IRBANK before listing, 7 class-share scope differences, and one Nagoya-listed ETF outside the TSE J-Quants master. The remaining 146 are explicitly unclassified; unequal effective dates prevent treating absence alone as proof of status.
